bio: Set in tranquil surroundings on the beautiful Lake Windermere, Macdonald Old England Hotel provides suitably traditional surroundings to enjoy the great British tradition of Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea can be served in either the Lounge or Terrace, where guests can enjoy breathtaking scenery of England's largest lake in peaceful surroundings.  Their Afternoon Tea menu is served on a classic three tiered stand comprising of a selection of traditional finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream and jam as well as an assortment of fine pastries. If you are feeling extra indulgent then you can upgrade to include a glass of Champagne.  Set in the heart of the Lake District in Cumbria, Macdonald Old England Hotel is the perfect base to explore one of the most scenic areas in Britain.
